head: 03f5cd48ba41cc5bc844ae9e3fbd739d8fc8a900
summary:
Attempt 2 (03f5cd4) does O-001 and nothing else, as the builder says.

- **Arming code in one place:** `Scans.CancelAt(guard, cts, call, during)` (Scans.cs:139-157) is now the only code that arms a guard. It sets BeforeCall to Cancel at call k, or sets AfterCall to call the shared cancel-and-spin at call k.
- **One cancel-and-spin:** `Scans.CancelDuringTheCall(cts, guard)` (Scans.cs:163-167) is the only copy of the cancel-then-spin-on-CancelIsIssued code with the 'the canceller never marked the call' message.
- **Callers:** RunCancellingAt (Scans.cs:132) is now `WithGuard(g => CancelAt(g, cts, call, during), …)`. CancelledFolderTests.AnAbortedListingKeepsNothingOfTheBuffersBeforeIt (:123) calls `Scans.CancelAt(guard, cts, ThirdBuffer, duringTheCall)`. Its old copy, which had lost the message, is gone. SynchronousIoCancelTests' private CancelDuringTheCall is deleted, and its two AfterCall hooks (:354, :365) call the Scans method.

A grep of tests finds the spin and message only at Scans.cs:166. Every remaining BeforeCall/AfterCall assignment is a different shape, not cancel-at-call-k:
- CancellationTests:83 and CloudRigTests:192/237 hold call 1 in a pipe wait or an event.
- SynchronousIoCancelTests:221 waits for !CancelIsIssued.

Behaviour is unchanged in each rewired test: the same guard, the same call number, the same order of cancel and spin, and AnAbortedListing still checks `guard.Calls == ThirdBuffer`. The comments that name the helpers still describe the code: Scans.cs doc comments, TopLevelTests.cs:242, and TopLevelRowTextTests.cs:10, which is about the unchanged OverrideQueryError 995 approach.

I ran the full default suite myself: 394 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, 22 s. I then ran the 9 tests that use the changed helpers 3 more times: 9/9 each time, 6–7 s. Two attempts, each sent back for a different reason (the design, then accepted finding m1), and neither touched src. That is not a loop.

Second round: Round two found nothing new. Attempt 2 adds no parser, matcher or reader, so the format-input checks do not apply. I tried to break the two new helpers from both the caller and callee side.

- **CancelAt (Scans.cs:139-157) assigns one hook only:** It sets AfterCall when `during` is true and BeforeCall otherwise, replacing any earlier value of that hook. None of its callers sets a hook first: RunCancellingAt hands it a guard that was just created, and CancelledFolderTests.cs:123 arms a guard it created two lines earlier.
- **Call number out of range:** A value of 0 or below, or past the last call, never fires. The listing then completes, and the caller's `Assert.Equal(SynchronousIoCancel.Aborted, error)` or its Cancelled-status assert fails loudly.
- **Assert thrown inside the spin:** If the assert in CancelDuringTheCall (Scans.cs:166) throws inside AfterCall, the exception goes through the guard's own finally, which calls Exit, and on through WithGuard's finally, which clears Created. Both CTS `using` scopes are unchanged.
- **SynchronousIoCancelTests.cs:354/365 still fire on every call:** They call CancelDuringTheCall with `_ =>` exactly as before. Cancel is idempotent, and each block makes only one call that the guard brackets and aborts.
- **Test results:** The full suite (394/394) and three repeated runs of the 9 tests that use these helpers passed in the first round, and nothing has changed since.

obligations.evidence: tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/Scans.cs:139-157 CancelAt holds the only arming code, and Scans.cs:163-167 CancelDuringTheCall holds the only cancel-and-spin with its message. RunCancellingAt (Scans.cs:132) is built on CancelAt. CancelledFolderTests.cs:123 calls Scans.CancelAt in place of its own copy, the one that had lost the message. SynchronousIoCancelTests.cs:354/365 call Scans.CancelDuringTheCall, and the private copy is deleted. Full suite 394/394 re-run by this review.
CancelledFolderTests.cs:44/67 and TopLevelTests.cs:269/276 use Scans.WithGuard and Scans.RunCancellingAt. Neither test keeps its own cancel-at-call-k loop body or Created set/reset.

drift: Nothing new departs from the design. The remaining hand-written SynchronousIoCancel.Created set/reset sites stay as the builder declared (CancellationTests x3, CancelledFolderTests.A995WindowsReturnsWithNoCancelIsAnUnreadableFolderAndTheScanCarriesOn x2 at :200/:215, StalledShareTests, CloudPlaceholderTests, CloudRigTests x2, TopLevelRowTextTests), and the builder raised moving them to WithGuard as a follow-up.
